name: parity-fork-notes
title: Annotate the upstream-only UI-parity harness as non-functional in this fork; rewrite README
description: The upstream UI-parity harness (playwright.parity.config.ts, tests/ui-parity/, scripts/{serve-legacy-baseline.mjs,add-hosts.ps1}) depends on the legacy Angular build (../aqua_viewer/dist/aqua-viewer/browser) which does not exist after forking, so it cannot run. Decided with the user to KEEP the files (deleting them would only have to be redone on every upstream sync) and instead document their fork status in the trellis spec + README, and rewrite the README which is too thin.
creator: Xavior
